entities.name: Mirza Yusuf
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Mirza Yusuf (mirza-yusuf) was the last sultan of the Qara Qoyunlu, also known as the Black Sheep Turkomans, to have significant authority. 

He reigned from 1468–1469 and died on October 31, 1469. His rule occurred during a period of great instability in the region.

Mirza Yusuf's significance lies in his ability to maintain some semblance of order in a tumultuous era. He was succeeded by other Turkic rulers who further fragmented the region.

His legacy is marked by the continued fragmentation of the region into smaller khanates and the eventual rise of the Safavid Empire.

Mirza Yusuf's death marked the end of an era, but his impact on the region would be felt for centuries to come.
